{{Quote|She has the sand fever. Face brighter red and she ranting a madness. Something must be done for Padawan.|Bleb-Blek|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Sand fever''' was an illness that one could contract on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Symptoms included red skin and ranting, and the fever could prove deadly.
